title: Design and implement mxo-track agent-native domain model
description: Design the full mxo-track logistics platform as an agent-native system. All entities are file-based, all operations are atomic primitives, agents compose capabilities via prompts.
acceptance_criteria: All entity types defined with JSON schemas
Entity directory structure follows agent-native conventions
CRUD operations documented for every entity
Operations defined as composable prompts, not hardcoded logic
Tracking, notifications, and optimization modeled as agent capabilities
